{ "rules": [
    "When sentiment is positive, pull forward bullish forecasts to avoid lagging behind price rallies",
    "Negative sentiment readings require delayed or softened bearish corrections to avoid overshooting declining prices",
    "Mean reversion bias: forecasts too far from recent price range need compression toward central tendency",
    "Sentiment strength modulation: weak sentiment signals (0.0-0.33) should have muted forecast deviations from baseline trend",
    "Overshoot correction: when forecast diverges sharply from price, pull toward observed price for next 5-10 days",
    "Sentiment reversal lag: when sentiment flips from positive to negative, maintain mildly positive forecasts for 2-3 days instead of instant reversal",
    "Price momentum mismatch: when prices show strong sustained direction, reduce forecast magnitude by 30-40%"
] }
